title: Embedding pin
description: Shape of packages/contracts/embedding.json, the one place that says which model init and the backend embed with. Meta schemas describe configuration files rather than messages, so their $id lives in the urn:fdp:meta namespace and never appears in a message's schema field. Two invariants JSON Schema cannot state are asserted by test/embedding.test.ts: every files[].url must equal https://huggingface.co/{model_id}/resolve/{revision}/{path} for its own entry, and dimension must equal the single vector(N) of db/migrations/0003_manual_chunks.sql and the length of every fixture vector.

model_id.description: Hugging Face repository id, `<owner>/<name>`, of the model both languages load.

revision.description: The repository commit the pin freezes; a tag or a branch would let the files move.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the model weights. Only a permissive licence is allowed, as for every runtime dependency (ground rule 9, CONTRIBUTING.md).

dimension.description: Vector length, and therefore the N of `vector(N)` in the manual-chunk migration.

pooling.description: How token vectors become one sentence vector: masked mean, or the CLS position.

normalize.description: Whether the pooled vector is L2-normalised, which makes cosine a plain dot product.

max_tokens.description: Truncation length in tokens; the chunker enforces it with the model's own tokenizer.

query_prefix.description: Text prepended to a retrieval query. Empty for a model that was not trained with one.

passage_prefix.description: Text prepended to an indexed passage. Empty for a model that was not trained with one.

onnx.description: The input and output names read off the real graph by scripts/embed_fixture.py pin.

inputs.description: Graph input names, in the order the runtimes build their feed.

output.description: The token-level output that pooling reduces, `(batch, sequence, dimension)`.

runtime.description: The four runtime pins, one per side of the parity test.

files.description: Every file both languages load, with the hash init verifies the download against.

fixture.description: The reference fixture, relative to this package: the contract the parity tests read.

commit_sha.title: Commit SHA
commit_sha.description: A full 40-character lowercase Git commit hash.

version.title: Runtime version
version.description: An exact version, never a range: both sides must run the same graph the same way.

model_file.title: Model file
model_file.description: One downloadable file of the pinned revision. Model files are never committed: init fetches them into the shared model-cache volume and verifies them against `sha256` and `bytes`.

path.description: Path inside the model repository, for example `onnx/model.onnx`.

bytes.description: Exact size in bytes; a short download fails before it is hashed.

url.description: Derived download URL, https://huggingface.co/{model_id}/resolve/{revision}/{path}. The derivation itself is asserted by test/embedding.test.ts.
